title: MCP registry search (Smithery Toolbox)
description: OPT-IN registry-search MCP for the composer analyst: live semantic search over the Smithery registry (7k+ servers) via the Smithery Toolbox meta-MCP. Catalog-only — NOT installed by any shipped flow. By default the analyst discovers MCP servers by web search (free, no-auth Official MCP Registry, no key); add this module to an agent or flow only when you want live in-session search. When added, it needs a free Smithery API key: the install writes a `${SMITHERY_API_KEY}` placeholder and the user fills it in this project's `.insight-flow/secrets.local.json` (project root, gitignored) — not the global `~/.insight-flow/`. Trust note: this runs third-party code (`@smithery/cli`) via npx; the CLI version is pinned (not `@latest`) so an install is reproducible — bump it deliberately.
name: mcp-registry

inputs.name: SMITHERY_API_KEY
inputs.title: Smithery API key
inputs.description: Free key from https://smithery.ai — lets the composer search the MCP registry. Store it in this project's .insight-flow/secrets.local.json (project root, gitignored), not the global ~/.insight-flow/.
